title: Sphere Decoder
text: Encode input message using orthogonal space-time block code, 1 input, 1 output; {Number of transmit antennas}, {Rate} sets the symbol rate and {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the option to saturate on integer overflow. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: Option to saturate on integer overflow off (default) | on
